name: Eswatini
dated: VAT Act 2011 with the VAT (Rates) Regulations (LN 52 of 2012 as amended by LN 112 of 2018) and LN 130 of 2025; ERS guide pages (live 2026-11-21) for the company rate and withholding taxes
sources: No usable 2025 text for these headings: the Income Tax Order 1975 extraction shows only individual tables; the company rate and the VAT Act 2011 text were not located. Fetched from ers.org.sz (`cmp20/global/R4/fetch/sz8/`, SHA256SUMS): VAT Act 2011, VAT Regulations, VAT (Rates) (Amendment) Regulations 2018 (OCR), VAT (Amendment) Act 2022 (OCR), LN 130 of 2025 (OCR), ERS pages 'Rates and thresholds', 'Withholding', 'VAT'. Pass 9 (excise): the Eswatini Revenue Service's Excise page (ers.org.sz/CustomExcise/Excisepage, saved in `R4/fetch/sz8/CustomExcise_Excisepage.html`) states that excise is charged at the rates of the SACU tariff schedule and links to SARS's 'Schedules to the Customs and Excise Act'; the 2025/2026 SACU rates are those read for ZA (Act 3 of 2026 Sch. II, `R4/fetch/za8/`).

vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: Value Added Tax Act 2011 s. 24 (3) (rate set by the VAT Regulations); VAT (Rates) Regulations (LN 52 of 2012) reg. 3 (1) as replaced by the VAT (Rates) (Amendment) Regulations 2018 (LN 112 of 2018, from 1 August 2018): 15 %; First Schedule (exempt), Second Schedule (zero-rated)
vat.doc: VAT Act 2011 s. 24 (3): "Subject to subsection (4), the rate of tax shall be as specified in the VAT Regulations"; (4): zero-rated supplies are those of the Second Schedule. LN 112 of 2018 reg. 2: "Legal Notice No. 52 of 2012 is amended in regulation 3 by deleting sub-regulation (1) and replacing it with ... (1) The rate of Value Added Tax shall be fifteen percent (15%)"; in force 1 August 2018. ERS 'VAT' page (2026): standard rate 15 % on most goods and services. First Schedule 1: exempt "(b) the supply of financial services; (c) the supply of insurance services; ... (f) the supply of education services; (g) the supply of medical, dental, and nursing services; ... (m) the supply of passenger transportation services, other than services ...; (n) the supply of tap water and sewage"; Second Schedule 1 (p): zero-rated "the supply of prescription drugs and medicines". LN 130 of 2025 (17 Dec 2025) restates tap water as exempt (Part B clause 1(1)(l)).
notes: the schedules were restructured into Parts A (services) and B (goods) by the VAT (Amendment) Act 2022 and LN 270 of 2022 (the schedule notice is not held: the ERS link answers 404); the 2011 schedule items are applied

Second Schedule basic foods (maize meal, maize, beans, milk, brown bread, fresh fruit and vegetables, eggs, vegetable oil) are zero-rated: the basket food line is processed food (region convention), so not applied
residential lettings exempt (First Schedule 1 (e)) not separable

excise.name: Excise duties (SACU common excise tariff, Schedule No. 1 Part 2A)
excise.statute: Customs and Excise Act 1971 Schedule No. 1 Part 2A (SACU common excise tariff): the 2024/2025 SACU rates to 11 March 2025 and the 2025/2026 rates from 12 March 2025, per the ERS Excise guide (rates 'indicated on the SACU tariff schedule') and SACU Agreement 2002 (as amended 12 April 2013) art. 21 (1): the Ministers responsible for Finance of all Member States 'meet and agree on the rates of specific excise and ad valorem excise duties ... to be applied to goods grown, produced or manufactured in or imported into the Common Customs Area'; art. 22: similar legislation [text version: sacu.int SACU-Agreement.pdf, Wayback 20210517172146, R4/fetch/gap/sacu_agreement_wb20210517.pdf]; rates as in SA Act 45 of 2024 Part I and Act 3 of 2026 Sch. II (lilangeni at par with the rand)
excise.doc: ERS Excise Duties page (facts restated): excise falls on alcoholic drinks, tobacco, road fuels, cars, TVs and refrigerators, collected on import into SACU or on local manufacture as in the other SACU states, at the rates of the SACU tariff schedule, which changes from time to time; alcohol and cigarettes bear specific duties. The page links the SARS 'Schedules to the Customs and Excise Act'. SACU 2025/2026 rates (SA Act 3 of 2026 Sch. II, deemed from 12 March 2025): "104.10.20 2203.00.90 Other R145.07/li aa"; "104.15.03 2204.21.41 ... R5.95/li"; "104.23.05 2208.30.10 ... R292.91/li aa"; "104.30.07 2402.20.90 ... R11.40/10". The lilangeni is at par with the rand. 2024/2025 rates: SA Act 45 of 2024 s. 1 (2) ('deemed to have come into operation on 21 February 2024') and Part I: '104.10.20 2203.00.90 Other R135.89/li aa', '104.15.03 2204.21.41 ... R5.57/li', '104.23.05 2208.30.10 ... R274.39/li aa', '104.30.07 2402.20.90 Other R10.89/10 cigarettes'; 2025/2026 rates: SA Act 3 of 2026 s. 4 (2) (12 March 2025) and Sch. II: R145.07/li aa, R5.95/li, R292.91/li aa, R11.40/10 (R4/fetch/za8/act-45-of-2024.txt, act-3-of-2026.txt).

cit.name: Corporate income tax
cit.statute: Income Tax Order 1975 (company rate 27,5 % since 1 July 2013), per the Eswatini Revenue Service guide (official secondary)
cit.doc: ERS 'Rates and thresholds' (live 2026-11-21; facts restated): companies pay 27,5 % of taxable income, since 1 July 2013. The Income Tax Order 1975 held prints only individual tables; the Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2023 (scanned) was not read. Grade B.
notes: the guide's sentence is undated beyond 'since 1 July 2013'; no later change found on the ERS pages

wht.name: Withholding on payments to non-residents
wht.statute: Income Tax Order 1975 (non-resident withholding taxes), per the ERS 'Withholding' guide (official secondary): royalties and management fees 15 %, services contracts 15 %, interest 10 %; twelfth pass: Income Tax Order 1975 s. 21 (2) (non-resident shareholders tax 15 %; the 12,5 % SACU proviso deleted by the Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2023 s. 10)
wht.doc: ERS 'Withholding' (live 2026-11-21): "Every person who makes any payment of royalty or management fee or both to a person not ordinarily resident in Swaziland is required to withhold tax. The rate of tax is fifteen percent of the gross amount of any management charge. The tax is final"; "The non-resident person is liable to withholding tax at the rate of fifteen percent on the gross amount of any payment derived by the non-resident under a Swaziland source services contract"; "The debtor ... shall withhold and remit to ERS tax equal to ten per cent of the interest that accrues to or in favour of the non-resident." Twelfth pass (kernel 2.3.0 grade-C withholding): dividend 15 %: Income Tax Order 1975 s. 21 (2) (non-resident shareholders tax 15 %; the 12,5 % SACU proviso deleted by the Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2023 s. 10)

rules.statute: ITO 1975 (ERS guide): management fees and services contracts 15 %
Income Tax Order 1975 s. 21 (2) (non-resident shareholders tax 15 %; the 12,5 % SACU proviso deleted by the Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2023 s. 10)
